source_scope: frozen site summaries only; no new biological response access

metrics.target_species_richness: observed eligible target species per site after prospective X-coordinate exclusion
metrics.individually_saturated_species_count: number of species tied for max species survival; because max survival=1 at all sites, this equals the number of individually fully surviving species
metrics.dominance_coverage: maximum species node coverage divided by guild-positive node count

interpretation: Exploratory evidence favors redundancy of individually continuous species over turnover-based complementarity as richness increases.
